Title: Mark single attendance with valid employeeId and absent status
Description: Verify that marking attendance for a single employee with valid employeeId and absent status returns 200 OK and the saved attendance record
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists in the system
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing valid employeeId and absent boolean
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains attendance record with matching employeeId and absent status
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record saved for employeeId 123 with absent=true and date set to current date

Title: Mark single attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify that marking attendance without employeeId returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify that marking attendance without absent field returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark single attendance with explicit date provided
Description: Verify that marking attendance with a specific date saves attendance for that date
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId, absent, and date
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify attendance record date matches the provided date
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record saved for employeeId 789 on 2024-05-15 with absent=false

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with a list of valid attendance DTOs returns 200 OK with correct counts and saved records
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array of valid attendance DTOs
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response body contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correctly calculated
Verify invalidEntries list is empty
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, presentCount=1, absentCount=1, invalidEntries=[]

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with empty list returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty JSON array
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Verify that batch attendance marking skips invalid entries and returns their employeeIds in invalidEntries list
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with JSON array containing valid and invalid attendance DTOs
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify savedCount equals number of valid entries
Verify invalidEntries contains employeeIds of invalid entries
Verify presentCount and absentCount are correct
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount=2, invalidEntries=[202], presentCount=1, absentCount=1

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify that marking batch attendance with null payload returns 400 Bad Request with appropriate message
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark single attendance updates employee counters correctly when changing from absent to present
Description: Verify that marking attendance for an existing record changes employee totalAbsent and totalPresent counters correctly when absent status changes from true to false
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists with totalAbsent > 0 and totalPresent >= 0, and existing attendance record marked absent=true
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId and absent=false for the same date as existing record
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify employee totalAbsent decreased by 1 and totalPresent increased by 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record updated and employee counters adjusted accordingly

Title: Mark single attendance updates employee counters correctly when changing from present to absent
Description: Verify that marking attendance for an existing record changes employee totalAbsent and totalPresent counters correctly when absent status changes from false to true
Pre-Conditions: Employee with employeeId exists with totalPresent > 0 and totalAbsent >= 0, and existing attendance record marked absent=false
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with employeeId and absent=true for the same date as existing record
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify employee totalPresent decreased by 1 and totalAbsent increased by 1
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with attendance record updated and employee counters adjusted accordingly
